meta.name: understand-domain
meta.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码库提取业务领域知识并生成交互式流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从现有代码中梳理业务逻辑和领域模型
copy.tagline_en: Extract business domain knowledge from codebase and generate interactive flow graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract business logic and domain models from existing code

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以分析你的代码库，自动提取其中的业务领域、流程和步骤，并在仪表盘中生成一个可交互的水平流程图。
howto.when: 当你说出“/understand-domain”命令，或要求分析代码库的业务知识时触发。可以带上 `--full` 参数强制重新扫描。

say.text: 分析这个项目的业务领域和流程。
say.note: Claude 会扫描代码并生成领域流程图。

say.text: 使用 --full 重新扫描代码库。
say.note: 即使已有缓存图，也会强制重新分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze your codebase, extract business domains, flows, and steps, and generate an interactive horizontal flow graph in the dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggered by the `/understand-domain` command or when you ask to analyze business domain knowledge. The `--full` flag forces a fresh scan even if a graph exists.

say_en.text: Analyze the business domains and flows of this project.
say_en.note: Claude scans the code and creates a domain flow graph.
Forces a fresh analysis even if a cached graph exists.
